note: Stage 5.15 (GOV-585) reviewer-internal role-transition model + owner-gate set. Encodes the real Stage 5 chain (impl -> VSR -> Security -> CTO -> CEO) plus the trust-mechanic handoffs (corrections / hot-topic / source-change / future-fact verification) and the five Isaac owner gates. Read by the deterministic evaluator (src/handoff-escalation.js). Supplied as DATA — the evaluator never invents transitions. No public output; AI-boundary preserved (GOV-471/436/420). Alpine-only.

transitions.note: Implementation complete -> verification. Carries source-grounded facts + the impl summary; review status preserved so VSR sees the impl self-review state.
Security pass -> CTO merge gate (non-author merge).
CTO merge -> CEO ledger flip / stage closeout. Merge commit SHA is a source-grounded fact.
Trust-mechanic: a filed correction (updates_statement_id spine, GOV-36) hands to review. Known-then context is never rewritten.
Trust-mechanic: a hot-topic salience flag (pure-arith) hands to review.
Trust-mechanic: a detected source change / Wayback lifecycle event hands to review.
Trust-mechanic: a past AI assumption later confirmed/refuted by a real-world outcome. laterVerification records the outcome WITHOUT rewriting the known-then record (GOV-36 typed-link discipline).
Stage parent ready to flip achieved + Stage-5 -> Stage-6 exit gate armed. Surfaced to the owner as a PROPOSAL, never an auto-unlock.
Isaac's decision on an owner-gated condition returns to the CTO to action. The only transition that does not require a carried review status.

ownerGates.note: Any public surface / send / web publish (GOV-420).
Any change to AI labeling / verification policy (GOV-471).
Any legal/privacy decision about an individual.
